pair_rule: next 8 subjectIDs after A and B, paired in order
rule_v2: v2: a density counts as a difference only if |A - B| > max(eps, REL_TOL x mean(|A|, |B|)), REL_TOL = 0.01; strength/weight metrics divided by each subject's mean|w|. setting-consistent = same sign at all K densities; partially consistent = one sign only, but negligible at some densities; construction-sensitive = both signs appear; no difference = negligible at all densities. Descriptive only, not a significance test.
rule_v1: setting-consistent iff all K deltas share one sign beyond eps (S_M = 1 and n_zero = 0); no difference iff all |delta| <= eps; otherwise construction-sensitive. Descriptive only, not a significance test.
note: Descriptive only. Five pairs of individuals; not a population result. v2 was fixed after the main pair was seen and before the 4 replication pairs were run.
